scale.4: directly supported by measurement or implementation

unknown_policy: unknown/NO_DATA cells are excluded from both weighted sums (renormalized), recorded with missing evidence, never mapped to a number or advantage
hard_constraints: all seven safety counters equal zero in every accepted run
identical frozen workload/contract/evaluator hashes across compared runs
crash/replay scenarios executed for both backends

verdict_rules.min_runs: >= 90 main runs + full independent rerun in a separate process/output dir
verdict_rules.pass: winner stable under sensitivity, no unknown cells among real candidates, all safety counters zero, probes rejected
verdict_rules.pass_with_limits: winner stable but unknown cells, weight-flip sensitivity, or inherited PASS_WITH_LIMITS dependencies bind the claim
verdict_rules.fail: any safety counter non-zero on the recommendation, any probe accepted, any incomparable pair scored
verdict_rules.incomparable: workload/contract/hash divergence between compared runs -> NO_DATA, never a winner

statistical_tolerance.formula: abs(a-b) for normalized scores; abs(a-b)/max(abs(a),abs(b)) for p95 and recovery medians
statistical_tolerance.policy: safety verdicts must be identical; missing comparables or deltas above the frozen bounds fail the evidence pipeline
